boards.school_name: State University of New York at New Paltz
boards.title: Your First Weekend at State University of New York at New Paltz, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A practical, under-21-safe sequence of campus and nearby New Paltz stops for getting oriented, finding activity, and exploring local culture.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union Atrium
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Student Union Building
cards.notes: Use the Atrium as an orientation point: check the Welcome Center, look over posted information, and identify the services you may return to during the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central first stop for campus information and bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz identifies the Atrium Welcome Center as located in the Student Union Building's Atrium Lobby.
cards.source_title: Atrium Welcome Center | SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: The Welcome Center lists regular hours of 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: HQ at the Student Union Desk
cards.title: Ask HQ about the Entertainment Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Student Union Atrium
cards.notes: Bring your student ID to the HQ Desk and ask about equipment for the Entertainment Commons before settling into a low-key game with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: A staffed desk that connects students with Union activities and game equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The HQ Desk provides information on events and involvement opportunities and signs out equipment for the Entertainment Commons pool and ping-pong tables.
cards.source_title: HQ at the Student Union | SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Show a student ID for Entertainment Commons equipment; the source lists a 50-cent pool-table charge and a 25-cent ping-pong equipment deposit.

cards.title: Have an early meal at Hawk's Nest
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Student Union Building
cards.notes: Use this campus dining stop to regroup, compare weekend plans, and keep the first evening simple before heading to another scheduled campus activity.
cards.short_summary: A named campus food court inside the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz lists the Hawk's Nest Food Court in the Student Union Building among its campus dining venues.
cards.source_title: Useful Information for New Employees | SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Food and meal-plan purchases may be required; verify current dining availability with Campus Dining.

cards.title: See the Dorsky galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Smiley Art Building
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit while the museum is open, then use the digital guide or a slow circuit through the exhibitions as a shared campus-culture stop.
cards.short_summary: Campus art museum with public galleries and an on-site digital guide.
cards.evidence_claim: The Samuel Dorsky Museum of Art is on the SUNY New Paltz campus and lists Wednesday–Sunday hours of 11 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Museum Visit | The Samuel Dorsky Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists a $5 suggested donation and asks visitors to follow gallery policies; hours may change.

cards.title: Make the library your reset point
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Walk through the library to locate the building for future study, then use the visit to organize plans or take a calm break between weekend stops.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library with weekend and evening building hours.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz lists the Sojourner Truth Library as an unlocked building, with Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday hours of noon–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Building Hours and Information | SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Current listed weekend hours are Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday noon–10 p.m.; check the library calendar for changes.

cards.title: Get a look at the Athletic & Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Athletic & Wellness Center
cards.notes: Find the building and review its facilities and schedule, then decide whether a future workout, track session, class, or game fits your routine.
cards.short_summary: The main campus wellness and recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz states that the Athletic & Wellness Center contains fitness centers, an indoor track, an 1,800-seat basketball arena, and other facilities.
cards.source_title: Construction at SUNY New Paltz: Elting Gym Renovation
cards.access_notes: Listed weekend building hours are Saturday noon–7 p.m. and Sunday 1–9 p.m.; facility use may have eligibility or schedule requirements.

cards.title: Locate the John R. Kirk Planetarium
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Coykendall Science Building
cards.notes: Add the planetarium to your campus mental map and check its program information before planning a return visit around a scheduled presentation or observation event.
cards.short_summary: A named planetarium housed in a central academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz states that Coykendall Science Building houses the John R. Kirk Planetarium.
cards.source_title: What's in a Building Name? | SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Program access and timing are not stated on the cited page; verify current planetarium programming before making a special trip.

cards.title: Check what is playing at McKenna Theatre
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · McKenna Theatre
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled theatre or campus arts event, and if one fits, make it the evening’s shared activity rather than relying on an unscheduled drop-in.
cards.short_summary: A named campus theatre building for checking current arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz lists McKenna Theatre among its campus dining locations through the Backstage Cafe and lists College Theatre building access information.
cards.source_title: Useful Information for New Employees | SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Performance availability, tickets, and entry requirements depend on the specific event; consult the current arts calendar.

cards.title: Walk Historic Huguenot Street
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · New Paltz village
cards.notes: Visit the historic district with time to read site interpretation, then choose a tour only if its schedule and admission details work for your group.
cards.short_summary: A local historic-site stop centered on New Paltz's multicultural settlement history.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Huguenot Street says its tours explore the multicultural history of the settlement known today as New Paltz.
cards.access_notes: Tours and museum access have admission conditions; the site specifically lists free admission for SUNY New Paltz students.

cards.title: End by checking the Union Ballroom calendar
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Student Union Building
cards.notes: Before the weekend ends, look for an upcoming student event in the Ballroom and save one date that gives you an easy reason to return to campus.
cards.short_summary: A renovated Student Union venue used for campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz reports that the renovated Student Union Ballroom is an indoor venue for students, faculty, staff, and guests.
cards.source_title: Students will love this space: Celebrating the new-and-improved Student Union | SUNY New Paltz News
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled event; the Student Union is currently listed open Saturday until midnight and Sunday until 9:30 p.m.
